title: DuckBlockedImmersive
description: An immersive world-blocking plugin that disables the Nether and End with stylish SmallCaps titles, sound effects, and full config support.
body:
# Duck-BlockedImmersive

Duck-BlockedImmersive is a modern, lightweight, and highly customizable world management plugin designed to restrict access to the Nether and The End with style. Instead of relying on boring, easily missed chat logs, this plugin enhances player immersion by utilizing striking full-screen titles, custom sound cues, and an elegant automated typographic formatting system.

Whether you are hosting a progression-based SMP, a hardcore faction server, or a timed event where dimensions unlock dynamically, Duck-BlockedImmersive offers a seamless, performance-optimized solution for managing your server's dimensions.

### Key Features

* Total Dimension Control: Easily toggle player access to both the Nether and The End on the fly.
* Immersive Visuals and Audio: Denied players are greeted with an elegant, customizable title and subtitle directly on their screens, accompanied by an audio warning.
* Built-in SmallCaps Formatter: Features an intelligent text engine inside the plugin that automatically converts your standard configuration text into a sleek SmallCaps look in-game, while fully preserving standard Minecraft color codes.
* Dynamic Configurations: Enable or disable dimensions via simple in-game commands. All changes are instantly written and saved to the config file without needing a server reload.
* Performance and Compatibility: Built with optimization in mind. It uses high-priority event handling to prevent bypasses and ensures zero server lag, fully supporting Paper and Spigot versions up to 1.21.4.
* Tab Completion Support: Smart auto-complete for commands ensures effortless server administration.

### Commands and Permissions

Manage everything in real-time with straightforward commands:

* /nether <on/off> - Toggle access to the Nether.
* /end <on/off> - Toggle access to The End.
* Permission node: duckblocked.admin (Required to toggle world access).

### Configuration File (config.yml)

Here is the complete configuration file showing all available settings and messages. (Note: The plugin automatically styles these messages in-game).

==================================================

# Duck-BlockedImmersive Config
prefix: "&e&lDUCK-BLOCKED &8»"

# Dimension Status
nether-enabled: false
end-enabled: false

messages:
  world-on: "&fSwiat &e{world} &fzostal &aWLACZONY&f!"
  world-off: "&fSwiat &e{world} &fzostal &cWYLACZONY&f!"
  
  # Screen Title Messages
  nether-title: "&e&lNETHER"
  nether-subtitle: "&fjest obecnie zablokowany!"
  
  end-title: "&e&lEND"
  end-subtitle: "&fjest obecnie zablokowany!"

==================================================
